newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar falls on poor demand, higher supplies.
newsitem.headline: India sugar falls on poor demand, higher supplies.

text.p: Sugar prices fell on sluggish demand and higher supplies on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Lower than expected buying by bulk consumers dragged prices downward," one trader said.
"Millers were active sellers in the wake of poor outstation enquiries," he said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell 25 rupees to 1,245/1,300 rupees per quintal while M-30 dropped 5/20 rupees to 1,290/1,360. Sugar mill delivery lost 20 rupees to 1,185/1,200.
